audio.text: Weren't you planning to take advanced statistics this term?

options: Yes, statistics is required for every major.
I was, but it clashed with my lab schedule.
I planned the trip for the end of term.
The advanced section meets on Tuesdays.

why.en: Negative question → "I was, but..." explains the change of plan. A says "Yes" about a different point; C repeats "plan" and "term" with no link to the course.
why.tr: Olumsuz soru → "I was, but..." plan değişikliğini açıklıyor. A başka bir konuda "Yes" diyor; C "plan" ve "term" kelimelerini dersle ilgisiz biçimde tekrar ediyor.
why.es: Pregunta negativa → "I was, but..." explica el cambio de planes. A dice "Yes" sobre otra cosa; C repite "plan" y "term" sin relación con la asignatura.
